title: Refine calendar loading logic across auth/actor/unlock transitions

requirements.text: Refine the authenticated loading flow so the UI never shows the Events/Tasks views (or their query-driven error states) until all prerequisites are satisfied: (1) Internet Identity is authenticated, (2) the backend actor is ready, (3) the user profile has been fetched (and profile setup completed if needed), and (4) the encryption session is unlocked. When these prerequisites are not yet satisfied, show a clear, non-destructive loading state (English text) instead of rendering query error alerts.

quotes: Let's refine the loading logic next.

acceptanceCriteria: After login (and after re-login), the app displays a consistent loading state while the actor/profile/unlock requirements are still resolving.
EventsView and TasksView are not rendered in a way that can produce a transient destructive error alert during normal startup (e.g., while actor/key/principal are still becoming available).
All user-facing loading/error text introduced or modified is in English.

requirements.text: Adjust React Query behavior for events/tasks fetching so that, after a logout/login cycle (including logging back in as the same principal) and subsequent unlock, the events and tasks queries reliably refetch and render fresh decrypted data without requiring a manual page refresh or the user pressing “Retry”. This should be achieved by refining the query enable/refetch conditions and/or invalidation strategy tied to actor readiness and unlock state (without editing files in frontend immutablePaths).

quotes: Let's refine the loading logic next.

acceptanceCriteria: Repro path: login → unlock → create at least one event/task → logout → login again → unlock → events/tasks load automatically and display the saved items.
No persistent “Failed to load events” / “Failed to load tasks” error appears in the above flow unless there is an actual backend/decryption failure.
If a real fetch/decrypt error occurs, the error state remains actionable (e.g., Retry still works) and does not get stuck due to stale query state from a prior session.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend.immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Respect the existing single-canister backend architecture; this request should be solvable purely via frontend loading/query behavior unless a backend defect is clearly identified.
nonGoals: Adding new product features beyond refining loading behavior (no new calendar capabilities, no new auth providers).
Changing the encryption scheme or re-encrypting existing stored data.
